Greek fixture files in this directory are short excerpts (a few verses each)
of the CCAT LXXMorph corpus (Rahlfs' Septuaginta), the same corpus used by the
CrossWire "LXX" SWORD module, converted to Unicode. They exist only so the
test suite can exercise the real Greek import pipeline offline.

License/terms: CCAT fair-use agreement (free non-commercial use; see
https://ccat.sas.upenn.edu/gopher/text/religion/biblical/lxxmorph/). These
excerpts are not part of the shipped product data.

Sources:
- 34.Sirach.txt  — Sirach prologue + chapter 1:1 (excerpt)
- 33.Wisdom.txt  — Wisdom of Solomon 1:1 (excerpt)
